title: Compact terminal UI
brief: Three constrained-terminal directions for Pi Atelier when expanded mode has little width or height, with footer activity/context always readable and iOS/Herdr limitations explicit.

artboards.title: Footer priority
artboards.tradeoff: Preserves the expanded rail and makes activity/context the last information to yield; secondary telemetry becomes less visible.

artboards.title: Focus stack
artboards.tradeoff: Maximizes transcript space by replacing the rail with a persistent activity/context stack; detailed panels require an explicit action.

artboards.title: Rail toggle
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps a familiar rail at comfortable sizes and collapses it cleanly at short heights; users must use F6 or Panels to reopen it.
